name: Badly Explained Plots: Egypt Edition
desc: An Egyptian film, series or play, explained badly. Name it.

100: A new female teacher is hired to get five students who have failed their final year of high school for over a decade to finally graduate.
Madraset El Moshaghebeen (مدرسة المشاغبين) (play)
The kids find a love letter to their dad from another woman and team up to stop him from leaving their mum.
El Eyal Kebret (العيال كبرت) (play)
A shy children's TV presenter is called as a witness in his neighbour's murder case and answers every question very, very badly.
Shahed Ma Shafsh Haga (شاهد ماشافش حاجة) (play)
A village mayor dies, and his twin sons (one raised in the village, one in America) fight over who gets to be in charge.

A man works his way up from nothing to owning a business, and his son wants absolutely nothing to do with it.
Lan Aeesh fi Gelbab Abi (لن أعيش في جلباب أبي) (TV)
